43 POUNDS OF POISON TAKEN OFF THE STREETS! 
 
11/29- An X-ray inspection of a pickup truck at the I-19 U.S. Border Patrol Checkpoint in Amado, AZ, flagged something that definitely didn't belong. Agents found 44 bundles of meth tucked away underneath the bed liner of a Chevy S-10. 
 
The drugs were seized, and the driver arrested on the spot- now facing federal drug possession charges. 
 
 @cbpgov @dhsgov @usbpchieftca

tweets.text:
12/1- In a coordinated enforcement operation, USBP and Texas DPS discovered several illegal aliens packed inside a stash house in Hidalgo County, TX- thanks to solid intel received from the Hidalgo County Sheriff's Office. 
The arrests included individuals originating from seven countries: 
 
▪️Peru 
▪️Colombia 
▪️Ecuador 
▪️Honduras 
▪️El Salvador 
▪️Guatemala 
▪️Mexico 
 
All individuals will be processed in accordance with immigration law. This operation is a definitive example of partnership in action, leveraging federal, state, and local teamwork to advance our shared border security goals.
@USBPChiefRGV @TxDPS

🔸Conviction for felony illegal reentry, served 57 months in prison 
🔸Multiple immigration encounters 
 
He'll now be prosecuted for felony illegal reentry and once that's done, he's heading right back out of the country.

TRUCK DRIVER WITH 15 ILLEGAL ALIENS- ARRESTED! 
12/1- A semi-truck arrived at a USBP checkpoint near Laredo, TX, for inspection. After an x-ray scan of the vehicle, the driver sped off in an attempt to flee. He didn't get far, agents stopped him minutes later on I-35 and uncovered the rest of the story: 15 illegal aliens hidden in the sleeper and the truck was stolen. 

The driver was arrested and faces prosecution for alien smuggling. The illegal aliens will be processed accordingly and deported.
 
@usbpchieflrt

71 LBS. OF HEROIN SEIZED – ILLEGAL ALIEN ARRESTED!
 
On 12/3, USBP agents, working with the Orange County Sheriff’s Office, stopped a grey sedan in Camp Pendleton, CA. The driver, an illegal alien, was arrested after a K9 alert led to the discovery of 71 lbs. of heroin hidden in the trunk.
 
The driver now faces prosecution for drug trafficking and will be deported after he serves his time. Another major victory in the fight against illegal drugs and crime!
